jobs.email_pitch: Dear Hiring Manager, I am a Dubai-based Operations Leader with 10 years of experience, including 9 years within the UAE transport sector. Having managed fleets across Uber, Careem, and other major platforms, I have built a deep expertise in fleet utilization, driver training, and RTA/platform compliance. Your focus on high-scale, real-time vehicle operations aligns perfectly with my background in managing 40 drivers and 30 vehicles with high efficiency standards. I am confident in my ability to scale your workforce operations and maintain your rigorous quality bar.

With 9 years of UAE-specific transport experience and a track record of driving operational efficiency, I would love to discuss how I can help optimize your fleet and workforce performance.
